events.details: Join us for a free, year-round \"Fitness at the Fort\" exercise program on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays! This fitness class incorporates climbing multiple staircases, stretches and strengthening exercises, notable tree identification, and forest bathing. Led by instructor, Nancy Bruning, BA, MPH, PAPHS. Classes are structured so that all levels of fitness will be accommodated; however, all classes involve relatively brisk walking and some stairs because of the layout of the park itself. Classes vary according to the season, path conditions, and the weather, but always meet at the Heather Garden entrance. Tuesday and Thursday classes end at various points near the starting point, including the volleyball courts. Saturday class ends at the Anne Loftus Playground, using the various pieces of equipment, and offers optional after-class group walk to the Greenmarket on Isham Street. events.title: New Dendrology at the Arsenal Gallery
events.description: New Dendrology is a group exhibition featuring eleven artists whose work contributes to the study of trees, offering new insight and connection bet...
events.details: New Dendrology is a group exhibition featuring eleven artists whose work contributes to the study of trees, offering new insight and connection between humans and their arboreal neighbors. From communing with streets trees through a reading with The New York City Street Tree Tarot deck by Matthew López-Jensen, to the commitment ceremonies officiated by Laura Nova , artworks featured in this exhibition invite you to engage in a new kind of relationship with trees. Featured Artist: Mariel Collard, Karin Giusti, Mark Heller, Anya Hoyer, Ekene Ijeoma, Gail Karlsson, sTo Len, Anthoula Lelekidis, Matthew López-Jensen, Amanda Lovelee, and Laura Nova. Image credit: The Bright Oak, 2019, Matthew López-Jensen

events.description: Immerse yourself in the wonders of the night sky every Tuesday on the High Line!
events.details: Immerse yourself in the wonders of the night sky every Tuesday on the High Line! The friendly team from the Amateur Astronomers Association-with whom we've been partnering since the park's opening-will be there with high-powered telescopes, ready to reveal the secrets of the cosmos. No experience is necessary and telescopes will be provided between sunset and park closure. This High Line program is free and open to visitors of all ages. No RSVP is required. Stargazing on the High Line is subject to cancellation due to overcast conditions or inclement weather. If a stargazing session needs to be cancelled, we'll add an alert to the High Line's webpage.
